title: Vault initialization trusts symlinked memory directories
description: Vault path validation uses stat() for required directories/files, so symlinked raw, wiki, ledgers, or .boreal/locks paths can look initialized while writes through raw add, wiki create, ledger append, or compact archive land outside the memory root.
acceptanceCriteria: Vault initialization and health checks reject required directories/files whose realpath escapes the configured memory root.
Raw, wiki, ledger, lock, and compaction writes all use the same realpath boundary guard.
Regression tests prove symlinked raw/wiki/ledgers/.boreal/locks paths cannot cause outside writes.
